$comment: Message surface (docs/design/message-surface-and-meta.md C1): which surface a timeline row draws its content on. Read by the Vue, Flutter, SwiftUI and Compose kit tests through each kit's messageSurface pure function. Content types use the spec vocabulary (components.json contentTypes.registered plus system, forward, thread, quote, custom); a kit maps its own wire names (rich_text, link_card, ...) onto them. Change the rules and the cases together.

rules.order: First match wins. 1 recalled or deleted: centered (the recall / delete notice line). 2 system or notification: centered. 3 the host registered a surface for the content's key (contentType:subtype first, then contentType): that surface, except bareMedia with a quote, which is bubble. 4 a quote: card stays card (the quote is drawn in the card shell's quote slot), every other content is bubble. 5 video: bareMedia without a caption, bubble with one. 6 text: bareMedia when it is a lone emoji, else bubble. 7 the defaults table. A content type the kit does not know draws its unknown-message body: bubble.
rules.loneEmoji: Input fact: the text is a single emoji pack token ("[smile]") or a single emoji, carries no mentions and is not markdown. Each kit derives it with its own emoji parser.
rules.hasQuote: Input fact: the message replies to another one (replyTo or quotePreview set).
rules.hasCaption: Input fact: the video carries a description or caption that is not blank.
rules.registration: A host registers a surface (card or bareMedia) only for a content key the kit does not know. Every custom / plugin content (red packets, polls and all flare.plugin.message.v1 cards) is card by default; the old boolean `bare` option is gone.
rules.cardShell: card: the content component's own shell is the surface (PluginView, RedPacketCard, LocationMessage, ContactMessage, ...). MessageBubble draws no background, border, padding, tail or shadow around it, and the shell width comes from richCardWidth, not from bubble padding. Outgoing and incoming cards differ by alignment only (and, in groups, the incoming avatar and name), never by a brand-coloured edge. A quote on a card is drawn inside the shell at its top (the shell's quote slot).
rules.bareMedia: bareMedia: the media is the surface; no bubble background, padding or tail.
rules.centered: centered: one centred notice line; no avatar, name, status, menu or selection.

palette.rule: How a bubble surface is painted, by side and delivery status. A bubble is drawn by its fill alone (no outline): incoming takes message.incoming.background with message.incoming.foreground, outgoing takes message.outgoing.background with message.outgoing.foreground. A failed outgoing bubble takes the failure surface instead: message.failed.background, message.failed.foreground for its text, and a 1px message.failed.border edge, the only edge a bubble has (the red edge carries the failure; the failed glyph in status.failed then sits on a light fill rather than the brand fill). Every other status (pending, sending, sent, read) keeps the side's palette. A failed status on someone else's message does not exist; a kit given one keeps the incoming palette. Cards and bare media are not bubbles: they keep their own surface and show a failure with the retry text key below (message-meta-placement-vectors.json rules.failed).
